```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
library(kableExtra)

```

```{r}
# 1. Load and derive raw metrics
raw <- read_csv("data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

derived <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    degshare              = (udeg + mdeg) / Employed,
    stemshare             = (ustemdeg + mstemdeg) / (udeg + mdeg),
    tightness             = nads / Unemployed,
    hpi_ch                = hpi_ch / 100,
    logpop                = log(pop),
    logincome             = log(medhhincome),
    pat_intensity         = n_inventors / Employed,
    patai_intensity       = ai_patents / n_patents,
    large_firms           = 1 - (small + medium) / est,
    information_intensity = information_emp / emp,
    manuf_intensity       = manuf_emp / emp,
    ai_intensity          = ai / nads * 100
  )

# 2. Compute early (2017–18) and late (2022–23) averages by state & county
summary_data <- derived %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2017,2018,2022,2023)) %>%
  mutate(period = ifelse(Year %in% c(2017,2018), "early", "late")) %>%
  group_by(state, COUNTY_FIPS, period) %>%
  summarise(across(
    c(ai_intensity, share_bac, share_black, share_poverty,
      logpop, hpi_ch, logincome, tightness,
      pat_intensity, patai_intensity,
      degshare, stemshare,
      large_firms, information_intensity,
      manuf_intensity, TurnOvrS),
    ~ mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)
  ), .groups="drop")

# 3. Pivot to wide, get _early and _late suffixes
wide <- summary_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = period,
    values_from = c(ai_intensity, share_bac, share_black, share_poverty,
                    logpop, hpi_ch, logincome, tightness,
                    pat_intensity, patai_intensity,
                    degshare, stemshare,
                    large_firms, information_intensity,
                    manuf_intensity, TurnOvrS)
  )

# 4. Filter out “small” counties: require early population ≥ 50,000
#    note: pop = exp(logpop), so pop >= 50000 <=> logpop >= log(50000)
threshold <- log(50000)
wide_large <- wide %>%
  filter(logpop_early >= threshold)

# 5. Compute changes and z‑score only the numeric early covariates
data2 <- wide_large %>%
  mutate(
    d_ai    = ai_intensity_late - ai_intensity_early,
    d_bac   = share_bac_late      - share_bac_early,
    d_black = share_black_late    - share_black_early,
    d_pov   = share_poverty_late  - share_poverty_early,
    d_pop   = logpop_late         - logpop_early,
    d_hpi   = hpi_ch_late         - hpi_ch_early,
    d_inc   = logincome_late      - logincome_early,
    d_tight = tightness_late      - tightness_early,
    d_pat   = pat_intensity_late  - pat_intensity_early,
    d_patai = patai_intensity_late- patai_intensity_early,
    d_deg   = degshare_late       - degshare_early,
    d_stem  = stemshare_late      - stemshare_early,
    d_large = large_firms_late    - large_firms_early,
    d_info  = information_intensity_late - information_intensity_early,
    d_manuf = manuf_intensity_late - manuf_intensity_early,
    d_turn  = TurnOvrS_late       - TurnOvrS_early
  ) %>%
  # Now scale *only* the early covariates we actually use
  mutate(
    z_share_bac_early             = scale(share_bac_early),
    z_share_black_early           = scale(share_black_early),
    z_share_poverty_early         = scale(share_poverty_early),
    z_logpop_early                = scale(logpop_early),
    z_hpi_ch_early                = scale(hpi_ch_early),
    z_logincome_early             = scale(logincome_early),
    z_tightness_early             = scale(tightness_early),
    z_pat_intensity_early         = scale(pat_intensity_early),
    z_patai_intensity_early       = scale(patai_intensity_early),
    z_degshare_early              = scale(degshare_early),
    z_stemshare_early             = scale(stemshare_early),
    z_large_firms_early           = scale(large_firms_early),
    z_information_intensity_early = scale(information_intensity_early),
    z_manuf_intensity_early       = scale(manuf_intensity_early),
    z_TurnOvrS_early              = scale(TurnOvrS_early)
  )

```

```{r}
m1 <- feols(d_ai ~ 
               z_share_bac_early  + z_share_black_early + z_share_poverty_early +
               z_logpop_early     + z_hpi_ch_early       + z_logincome_early +
               z_tightness_early,
             data = data2, cluster="COUNTY_FIPS")

m2 <- feols(d_ai ~ 
               z_pat_intensity_early + z_patai_intensity_early +
               z_degshare_early     + z_stemshare_early,
             data = data2, cluster="COUNTY_FIPS")

m3 <- feols(d_ai ~ 
               z_large_firms_early + z_information_intensity_early +
               z_manuf_intensity_early + z_TurnOvrS_early,
             data = data2, cluster="COUNTY_FIPS")

m4 <- feols(d_ai ~ 
               z_share_bac_early  + z_share_black_early + z_share_poverty_early +
               z_logpop_early     + z_hpi_ch_early       + z_logincome_early +
               z_tightness_early  + z_pat_intensity_early + z_patai_intensity_early +
               z_degshare_early   + z_stemshare_early    + z_large_firms_early +
               z_information_intensity_early + z_manuf_intensity_early + z_TurnOvrS_early,
             data = data2, cluster="COUNTY_FIPS")

m5 <- feols(d_ai ~ 
               z_share_bac_early  + z_share_black_early + z_share_poverty_early +
               z_logpop_early     + z_hpi_ch_early       + z_logincome_early +
               z_tightness_early  + z_pat_intensity_early + z_patai_intensity_early +
               z_degshare_early   + z_stemshare_early    + z_large_firms_early +
               z_information_intensity_early + z_manuf_intensity_early + z_TurnOvrS_early
             | state,
             data = data2, cluster="COUNTY_FIPS")

```

```{r}
coef_map <- c(
  z_share_bac_early             = "Bachelors, % z-score in 2017",
  z_share_black_early           = "Black, % z-score in 2017",
  z_share_poverty_early         = "Poverty, % z-score in 2017",
  z_logpop_early                = "Pop. Growth",
  z_hpi_ch_early                = "House Price Growth, z-score",
  z_logincome_early             = "Income, log z-score",
  z_tightness_early             = "Tightness, z-score",
  z_pat_intensity_early         = "Patents per emp., z-score",
  z_patai_intensity_early       = "AI Patents’ Share, z-score",
  z_degshare_early              = "Degrees per cap., z-score",
  z_stemshare_early             = "STEM Degrees’ share, z-score",
  z_large_firms_early           = "Large Estab., z-score",
  z_information_intensity_early = "ICT Intensity, z-score",
  z_manuf_intensity_early       = "Manufacturing Intensity, z-score",
  z_TurnOvrS_early              = "Turnover Rate, z-score"
)

modelsummary(
  list(
    "Demographics" = m1,
    "Innovation"   = m2,
    "Industry"     = m3,
    "All Controls" = m4,
    "All + State FE"= m5
  ),
  coef_map  = coef_map,
  stars     = TRUE,
  statistic = "({std.error})",
  gof_omit  = "IC|Log|Adj|RMSE",
  title     = "Table 2: Change in AI Share (Pop ≥ 50K)",
  output    = "kableExtra"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width=FALSE, position="center")

```
